package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os/signal"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
	"go.uber.org/zap"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/config"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	aipromptadapter "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/aiprompt"
	courseadapter "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/course"
	dialogadapter "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/dialog"
	learningplanneradapter "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/learningplanner"
	practiceadapter "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/practice"
	statisticadapter "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/statistic"
	studentadapter "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/student"
	telegramadapter "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/telegram"
	natsadapter "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/messaging/nats"
	pgadapter "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	httptransport "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http"
	adminhandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/handlers"
	apihandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	telegramtransport "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/integrations/telegram"
	privatehandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	messageadapter "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/message/nats"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/assistance"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/courseplannotification"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/curriculum"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/intervention"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/learningsession"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/nextbestaction"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/onboarding"
	outboxuc "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/outbox"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/personalteacher"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/studentcontext"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/teacherdialog"
	telegramuc "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/telegram"
)

type uuidGenerator struct{}

func (uuidGenerator) NewID() string { return uuid.NewString() }

type systemClock struct{}

func (systemClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now() }

func main() {
	logger, err := zap.NewProduction()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = logger.Sync() }()

	cfg, err := config.Load()
	if err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("load configuration", zap.Error(err))
	}
	if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("validate configuration", zap.Error(err))
	}

	startupContext, startupCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer startupCancel()
	pool, err := pgadapter.NewPool(startupContext, cfg.DatabaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("connect to postgres", zap.Error(err))
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	// S8 is deployed independently from its migration.  Detect the ledger once
	// at startup: an S7 database must not receive a claim query mentioning a
	// table it does not have, while an installed ledger must keep draining after
	// new S8 admissions are switched off.
	var handoffSchemaInstalled bool
	if err := pool.QueryRow(startupContext, `SELECT to_regclass('teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff') IS NOT NULL`).Scan(&handoffSchemaInstalled); err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("check teacher onboarding handoff schema", zap.Error(err))
	}
	var pathOutcomeSchemaInstalled bool
	if err := pool.QueryRow(startupContext, `SELECT to_regclass('teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox') IS NOT NULL`).Scan(&pathOutcomeSchemaInstalled); err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("check teacher onboarding path outcome schema", zap.Error(err))
	}
	if cfg.OnboardingPathOutcomeEnabled && !pathOutcomeSchemaInstalled {
		logger.Fatal("teacher onboarding path outcome schema is not ready")
	}
	var sessionContractInstalled bool
	if err := pool.QueryRow(startupContext, `
SELECT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
 WHERE table_schema=current_schema() AND table_name='teacher_onboarding_interaction' AND column_name='session_schema_version'
) AND EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger
 WHERE tgrelid=to_regclass('teacher_onboarding_interaction')
   AND tgname='trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_session_schema_version' AND NOT tgisinternal
) AND to_regclass('teacher_onboarding_terminal_session') IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger
   WHERE tgrelid=to_regclass('teacher_onboarding_terminal_session')
     AND tgname='trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session' AND NOT tgisinternal
) AND EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger
   WHERE tgrelid=to_regclass('teacher_onboarding_terminal_session')
     AND tgname='trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_delete' AND NOT tgisinternal
) AND EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger
   WHERE tgrelid=to_regclass('teacher_onboarding_terminal_session')
     AND tgname='trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_truncate' AND NOT tgisinternal
)`).Scan(&sessionContractInstalled); err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("check teacher onboarding session contract", zap.Error(err))
	}
	if !sessionContractInstalled {
		logger.Fatal("teacher onboarding session contract migration 023 is not ready")
	}
	handoffCredentialConfigured := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.LearningPlannerTeacherToken) != ""
	if handoffSchemaInstalled && !handoffCredentialConfigured {
		var pendingHandoffs bool
		if err := pool.QueryRow(startupContext, `SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff WHERE status IN ('queued','dispatching','accepted','message_pending','active_path'))`).Scan(&pendingHandoffs); err != nil {
			logger.Fatal("check pending teacher onboarding handoffs", zap.Error(err))
		}
		if pendingHandoffs {
			logger.Warn("S8 ledger drain is blocked: LEARNING_PLANNER_TEACHER_TOKEN is not configured")
		}
	}
	consumerConnection, err := natsgo.Connect(
		cfg.NATSURL,
		natsgo.Name("ms-go-teacher-agent-consumers"),
		natsgo.Timeout(time.Duration(cfg.NATSConnectTimeoutSeconds)*time.Second),
		natsgo.MaxReconnects(-1),
		natsgo.ReconnectWait(time.Second),
	)
	if err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("connect to nats for learning action consumer", zap.Error(err))
	}
	defer func() {
		if err := consumerConnection.Drain(); err != nil {
			logger.Warn("drain learning action consumer", zap.Error(err))
		}
	}()

	teachers := pgadapter.PersonalTeacherRepository{Pool: pool}
	decisions := pgadapter.TeacherDecisionRepository{Pool: pool}
	assistanceRepository := pgadapter.LearningActionAssistanceRepository{Pool: pool}
	// Migration 021 is deliberately optional while S8 is dark. Keep an S7
	// database free of ledger references; after 021 exists, retain the fence so
	// previously admitted work drains safely even if new admissions are off.
	dialogJobRepository := pgadapter.TeacherDialogJobRepository{Pool: pool, DenseOrderingEnabled: cfg.TeacherDialogDenseOrderingEnabled, HandoffEnabled: handoffSchemaInstalled}
	contextSummaryRepository := pgadapter.TeacherContextSummaryRepository{Pool: pool}
	contextMutationRepository := pgadapter.TeacherContextMutationRepository{Pool: pool}
	interventionRepository := pgadapter.InterventionRepository{Pool: pool}
	coursePlanNotificationRepository := pgadapter.CoursePlanNotificationRepository{Pool: pool}
	telegramRepository := pgadapter.TelegramRepository{Pool: pool}
	onboardingActionRepository := pgadapter.OnboardingActionRepository{Pool: pool}
	onboardingTurnRepository := pgadapter.TeacherOnboardingTurnRepository{Pool: pool}
	onboardingHandoffRepository := pgadapter.TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository{Pool: pool}
	onboardingTerminalSessionRepository := pgadapter.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionRepository{Pool: pool}
	onboardingPathOutcomeRepository := pgadapter.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRepository{Pool: pool}
	outboxRepository := pgadapter.OutboxRepository{Pool: pool}
	eventPublisher := &natsadapter.Publisher{
		URL:            cfg.NATSURL,
		Name:           "ms-go-teacher-agent-outbox",
		ConnectTimeout: time.Duration(cfg.NATSConnectTimeoutSeconds) * time.Second,
	}
	defer eventPublisher.Close()
	outboxRelay := outboxuc.Relay{
		Outbox:         outboxRepository,
		Publisher:      eventPublisher,
		Clock:          systemClock{},
		WorkerID:       "teacher-agent-" + uuid.NewString(),
		BatchSize:      cfg.OutboxBatchSize,
		LockTTL:        time.Duration(cfg.OutboxLockTTLSeconds) * time.Second,
		PublishTimeout: time.Duration(cfg.OutboxPublishTimeoutSeconds) * time.Second,
		RetryBaseDelay: time.Duration(cfg.OutboxRetryBaseSeconds) * time.Second,
		RetryMaxDelay:  time.Duration(cfg.OutboxRetryMaxSeconds) * time.Second,
	}
	outboxPollInterval := time.Duration(cfg.OutboxPollIntervalMS) * time.Millisecond
	relayContext, stopRelay := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	var relayWaitGroup sync.WaitGroup
	relayWaitGroup.Add(1)
	go func() {
		defer relayWaitGroup.Done()
		runOutboxRelay(relayContext, logger, outboxRelay, outboxPollInterval)
	}()
	defer func() {
		stopRelay()
		relayWaitGroup.Wait()
	}()

	ensureTeacher := personalteacher.Ensure{Teachers: teachers, IDs: uuidGenerator{}, Clock: systemClock{}}
	ensureTeacherSoul := personalteacher.EnsureSoul{Teachers: teachers, IDs: uuidGenerator{}, Clock: systemClock{}}
	getTeacher := personalteacher.Get{Teachers: teachers}
	getTeacherSoul := personalteacher.GetSoul{Teachers: teachers}
	updateTeacher := personalteacher.Update{Teachers: teachers, Clock: systemClock{}}
	updateTeacherSoul := personalteacher.UpdateSoul{Teachers: teachers, Clock: systemClock{}}
	finalizeAssistance := assistance.Finalize{
		Teachers:   ensureTeacher,
		Decisions:  decisions,
		Assistance: assistanceRepository,
		IDs:        uuidGenerator{},
		Clock:      systemClock{},
	}
	consumerContext, stopConsumer := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer stopConsumer()
	learningActionSubscriber := messageadapter.LearningActionClosedSubscriber{
		Conn:    consumerConnection,
		Handler: finalizeAssistance.Handle,
		Logger:  logger,
	}
	if err := learningActionSubscriber.Subscribe(consumerContext); err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("subscribe to learning action closures", zap.Error(err))
	}

	dependencyHTTPClient := &http.Client{Timeout: time.Duration(cfg.DependencyTimeoutSeconds) * time.Second}
	aiPromptHTTPClient := &http.Client{Timeout: time.Duration(cfg.AIPromptTimeoutSeconds) * time.Second}
	studentClient := studentadapter.Client{
		BaseURL: cfg.StudentServiceBaseURL, InternalToken: cfg.StudentServiceInternalToken,
		LearningWorkspaceToken: cfg.StudentServiceTeacherToken,
		HTTPClient:             dependencyHTTPClient,
	}
	learningPlannerClient := learningplanneradapter.Client{
		BaseURL: cfg.LearningPlannerBaseURL, InternalToken: cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken,
		HandoffToken: cfg.LearningPlannerTeacherToken, HTTPClient: dependencyHTTPClient,
	}
	practiceClient := practiceadapter.Client{
		BaseURL: cfg.PracticeServiceBaseURL, InternalToken: cfg.PracticeServiceInternalToken,
		HTTPClient: dependencyHTTPClient,
	}
	courseClient := courseadapter.Client{
		BaseURL: cfg.CourseServiceBaseURL, InternalToken: cfg.CourseServiceInternalToken,
		HTTPClient: dependencyHTTPClient,
	}
	dialogClient := dialogadapter.Client{
		BaseURL: cfg.DialogServiceBaseURL, InternalToken: cfg.DialogServiceInternalToken,
		SpaceKey:   cfg.DialogSpaceKey,
		HTTPClient: dependencyHTTPClient,
	}
	coursePlanNotificationHandler := courseplannotification.Handler{
		Teachers: ensureTeacher, Store: coursePlanNotificationRepository, Dialogs: dialogClient, Clock: systemClock{},
	}
	coursePlanOutcomeSubscriber := messageadapter.CoursePlanOutcomeSubscriber{
		Conn: consumerConnection, Handler: coursePlanNotificationHandler.Handle, Logger: logger,
	}
	if err := coursePlanOutcomeSubscriber.Subscribe(consumerContext); err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("subscribe to course plan outcomes", zap.Error(err))
	}
	if cfg.OnboardingPathOutcomeEnabled && pathOutcomeSchemaInstalled {
		pathOutcomeSubscriber := messageadapter.PlannerOnboardingPathOutcomeSubscriber{
			Conn: consumerConnection,
			Handler: (onboarding.PathOutcomeHandler{
				Handoffs: onboardingHandoffRepository, Outcomes: onboardingPathOutcomeRepository,
				Readiness: learningPlannerClient, Dialogs: dialogClient, Clock: systemClock{},
			}).Handle,
			Logger: logger,
		}
		if err := pathOutcomeSubscriber.Subscribe(consumerContext); err != nil {
			logger.Fatal("subscribe to planner onboarding path outcomes", zap.Error(err))
		}
	}
	statisticClient := statisticadapter.Client{
		BaseURL: cfg.StatisticServiceBaseURL, InternalToken: cfg.StatisticServiceInternalToken,
		HTTPClient: dependencyHTTPClient,
	}
	aiPromptClient := aipromptadapter.Client{
		BaseURL: cfg.AIPromptServiceBaseURL, InternalToken: cfg.AIPromptServiceInternalToken,
		HTTPClient: aiPromptHTTPClient,
	}
	dialogIntake := teacherdialog.Intake{Jobs: dialogJobRepository, Clock: systemClock{}}
	dialogRequestSubscriber := messageadapter.DialogTeacherRequestedSubscriber{
		Conn: consumerConnection, Handler: dialogIntake.Handle, Logger: logger,
	}
	if err := dialogRequestSubscriber.Subscribe(consumerContext); err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("subscribe to dialog teacher requests", zap.Error(err))
	}
	contextMutationHandler := teacherdialog.ContextMutationHandler{Mutations: contextMutationRepository, Clock: systemClock{}}
	contextMutationSubscriber := messageadapter.DialogTeacherContextMutatedSubscriber{
		Conn: consumerConnection, Handler: contextMutationHandler.Handle, Logger: logger,
	}
	if err := contextMutationSubscriber.Subscribe(consumerContext); err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("subscribe to dialog teacher context mutations", zap.Error(err))
	}
	interventionRegistry, err := intervention.NewRegistry(
		domain.DefaultInterventionMode,
		intervention.ThresholdPolicy{Mode: "balanced", MinimumFailures: 3, MinimumActiveSeconds: 480},
		intervention.ThresholdPolicy{Mode: "quiet", MinimumFailures: 5, MinimumActiveSeconds: 900},
		intervention.ThresholdPolicy{Mode: "proactive", MinimumFailures: 3, MinimumActiveSeconds: 300, OfferAfterIdleSeconds: 900},
	)
	if err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("configure intervention policies", zap.Error(err))
	}
	interventionEngine := intervention.Engine{
		Teachers: ensureTeacher, Policies: interventionRegistry, Store: interventionRepository,
		Dialogs: dialogClient, IDs: uuidGenerator{}, Clock: systemClock{},
	}
	activitySubscriber := messageadapter.LearningActivitySubscriber{
		Conn: consumerConnection, Handler: interventionEngine.Handle, Logger: logger,
	}
	if err := activitySubscriber.Subscribe(consumerContext); err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("subscribe to interesting learning activity", zap.Error(err))
	}
	pedagogyRegistry, err := teacherdialog.NewPedagogyRegistry(
		domain.DefaultPedagogyMethodCode,
		teacherdialog.ProgressiveHintMethod{},
	)
	if err != nil {
		logger.Fatal("configure pedagogy methods", zap.Error(err))
	}
	dialogWorker := teacherdialog.Worker{
		Jobs: dialogJobRepository, Teachers: getTeacher, Souls: getTeacherSoul,
		NextActions: studentClient,
		StudentContext: studentcontext.Build{
			Actions: studentClient, Code: studentClient, Mastery: studentClient, Overview: studentClient,
			Practice: practiceClient, PracticeValidation: practiceClient,
		},
		PromptContext: teacherdialog.ContextBuilder{Summaries: contextSummaryRepository, Summarizer: aiPromptClient},
		CourseLessons: courseClient, AssignedLessons: studentClient,
		DialogReader: dialogClient, DialogAppender: dialogClient, Decisions: decisions,
		Pedagogy: pedagogyRegistry, Generator: aiPromptClient,
		ChannelDelivery:    telegramRepository,
		PracticeAssistance: practiceClient,
		IDs:                uuidGenerator{}, Clock: systemClock{}, WorkerID: "teacher-dialog-" + uuid.NewString(),
		LeaseTTL:                  time.Duration(cfg.TeacherDialogWorkerLeaseSeconds) * time.Second,
		LeaseRenewInterval:        time.Duration(cfg.TeacherDialogLeaseRenewSeconds) * time.Second,
		MaxAttempts:               cfg.TeacherDialogMaxAttempts,
		RetryBaseDelay:            time.Duration(cfg.TeacherDialogRetryBaseSeconds) * time.Second,
		RetryMaxDelay:             time.Duration(cfg.TeacherDialogRetryMaxSeconds) * time.Second,
		UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled: cfg.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled,
		OnboardingCoordinator: teacherdialog.OnboardingCoordinator{
			Jobs: dialogJobRepository, Turns: onboardingTurnRepository, Receipts: onboardingActionRepository,
			StudentTurns: studentClient, Students: studentClient, Semantic: aiPromptClient, DialogReader: dialogClient, Appender: dialogClient,
			Readiness: learningPlannerClient, Deliveries: dialogJobRepository, ProductResponses: dialogJobRepository,
			Handoffs: onboardingHandoffRepository, PlannerHandoffEnabled: cfg.OnboardingPlannerHandoffEnabled, Clock: systemClock{},
		},
	}
	dialogWorkerContext, stopDialogWorker := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	var dialogWorkerWaitGroup sync.WaitGroup
	dialogWorkerWaitGroup.Add(cfg.TeacherDialogWorkerConcurrency)
	for workerIndex := 0; workerIndex < cfg.TeacherDialogWorkerConcurrency; workerIndex++ {
		workerInstance := dialogWorker
		workerInstance.WorkerID = fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", dialogWorker.WorkerID, workerIndex)
		go func() {
			defer dialogWorkerWaitGroup.Done()
			runTeacherDialogWorker(
				dialogWorkerContext, logger, workerInstance,
				time.Duration(cfg.TeacherDialogWorkerPollIntervalMS)*time.Millisecond,
				cfg.TeacherDialogWorkerBatchSize,
			)
		}()
	}
	defer func() {
		stopDialogWorker()
		dialogWorkerWaitGroup.Wait()
	}()
	if handoffSchemaInstalled && handoffCredentialConfigured {
		handoffWorker := onboarding.HandoffWorker{
			Store: onboardingHandoffRepository, Planner: learningPlannerClient, Readiness: learningPlannerClient,
			Responses: dialogClient, Proactive: dialogClient, ChannelDelivery: telegramRepository,
			IDs: uuidGenerator{}, Clock: systemClock{}, WorkerID: "onboarding-handoff-" + uuid.NewString(),
			LeaseTTL:       time.Duration(cfg.OnboardingHandoffLeaseSeconds) * time.Second,
			RetryBaseDelay: time.Duration(cfg.OnboardingHandoffRetryBaseSeconds) * time.Second,
			RetryMaxDelay:  time.Duration(cfg.OnboardingHandoffRetryMaxSeconds) * time.Second,
			MaxAttempts:    cfg.OnboardingHandoffMaxAttempts,
		}
		handoffWorkerContext, stopHandoffWorker := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		var handoffWorkerWaitGroup sync.WaitGroup
		handoffWorkerWaitGroup.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer handoffWorkerWaitGroup.Done()
			runOnboardingHandoffWorker(handoffWorkerContext, logger, &handoffWorker, time.Duration(cfg.OnboardingHandoffPollIntervalMS)*time.Millisecond)
		}()
		defer func() {
			stopHandoffWorker()
			handoffWorkerWaitGroup.Wait()
		}()
	}
	var apiTelegramHandler *apihandlers.TelegramChannelHandler
	var telegramWebhookHandler *telegramtransport.Handler
	if cfg.TelegramEnabled() {
		telegramService := &telegramuc.Service{
			Teachers: ensureTeacher, Dialogs: dialogClient, Messages: dialogClient, Store: telegramRepository,
			Tokens: uuidGenerator{}, Clock: systemClock{}, BotUsername: cfg.TelegramBotUsername,
		}
		apiTelegramHandler = &apihandlers.TelegramChannelHandler{Links: telegramService, Enabled: true}
		telegramWebhookHandler = &telegramtransport.Handler{Secret: cfg.TelegramWebhookSecret, Processor: telegramService}
		telegramWorker := telegramuc.DeliveryWorker{
			Store:  telegramRepository,
			Sender: telegramadapter.Client{BaseURL: cfg.TelegramAPIBaseURL, BotToken: cfg.TelegramBotToken, HTTPClient: dependencyHTTPClient},
			Tokens: uuidGenerator{}, Clock: systemClock{},
			LeaseTTL:       time.Duration(cfg.TelegramWorkerLeaseSeconds) * time.Second,
			RetryBaseDelay: time.Duration(cfg.TelegramRetryBaseSeconds) * time.Second,
			RetryMaxDelay:  time.Duration(cfg.TelegramRetryMaxSeconds) * time.Second,
		}
		telegramWorkerContext, stopTelegramWorker := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		var telegramWorkerWaitGroup sync.WaitGroup
		telegramWorkerWaitGroup.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer telegramWorkerWaitGroup.Done()
			runTelegramWorker(telegramWorkerContext, logger, telegramWorker, time.Duration(cfg.TelegramWorkerPollIntervalMS)*time.Millisecond)
		}()
		defer func() {
			stopTelegramWorker()
			telegramWorkerWaitGroup.Wait()
		}()
	}

	apiTeacherHandler := &apihandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{
		EnsureUC:     ensureTeacher,
		UpdateUC:     updateTeacher,
		SoulUC:       ensureTeacherSoul,
		SoulUpdateUC: updateTeacherSoul,
	}
	apiTeacherDialogHandler := &apihandlers.TeacherDialogHandler{
		ProvisionUC: teacherdialog.Provision{Teachers: ensureTeacher, Dialogs: dialogClient},
	}
	curriculumPlanner := curriculum.Planner{
		Teachers: ensureTeacher, Overview: studentClient,
		Plans: learningPlannerClient,
	}
	apiCurriculumHandler := &apihandlers.CurriculumHandler{Planner: curriculumPlanner, Diagnostic: curriculum.Diagnostic{Gateway: learningPlannerClient, Overview: studentClient, Plans: learningPlannerClient}}
	apiLearningSessionHandler := &apihandlers.LearningSessionHandler{Summarizer: learningsession.Summarizer{
		Teachers: ensureTeacher, Sessions: studentClient, Analytics: statisticClient, Dialogs: dialogClient,
		Curriculum: curriculumPlanner,
	}}
	onboardingService := &onboarding.Service{
		Teachers: ensureTeacher, Dialogs: dialogClient, Sources: dialogClient,
		StructuredMessages: dialogClient, PlainMessages: dialogClient, Students: studentClient,
		CanonicalMessages: dialogClient, CanonicalActionsEnabled: cfg.OnboardingCanonicalActionsEnabled, UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled: cfg.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled,
		Readiness: learningPlannerClient, ProductAwareEnabled: cfg.ProductAwareOnboardingEnabled,
		Handoffs: onboardingHandoffRepository, PlannerHandoffEnabled: cfg.OnboardingPlannerHandoffEnabled,
		TerminalSessions: onboardingTerminalSessionRepository,
		PathOutcomes:     onboardingPathOutcomeRepository, PathOutcomeEnabled: cfg.OnboardingPathOutcomeEnabled,
		Receipts: onboardingActionRepository, Interactions: onboardingTurnRepository, IDs: uuidGenerator{}, Clock: systemClock{},
		LeaseTTL: time.Duration(cfg.OnboardingActionLeaseSeconds) * time.Second,
	}
	apiOnboardingHandler := &apihandlers.TeacherOnboardingHandler{Ensurer: onboardingService, Actions: onboardingService}
	apiNextBestActionHandler := &apihandlers.NextBestActionHandler{Getter: nextbestaction.Get{
		Enabled: cfg.NextBestActionEnabled, Actions: studentClient,
	}}
	adminTeacherHandler := &adminhandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{GetUC: getTeacher, SoulUC: getTeacherSoul}
	readyCheck := func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if err := pool.Ping(ctx); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var denseSchemaReady, productSchemaReady, handoffSchemaReady, sessionContractReady bool
		if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_name='teacher_dialog_job' AND column_name='teacher_turn_schema_version'
) AND to_regclass('teacher_dialog_turn_cursor') IS NOT NULL
AS dense_ready,
EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_name='teacher_onboarding_interaction' AND column_name='closed_reason'
) AS product_ready,
to_regclass('teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff') IS NOT NULL AS handoff_ready,
EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema=current_schema() AND table_name='teacher_onboarding_interaction' AND column_name='session_schema_version'
) AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger
    WHERE tgrelid=to_regclass('teacher_onboarding_interaction')
      AND tgname='trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_session_schema_version' AND NOT tgisinternal
) AND to_regclass('teacher_onboarding_terminal_session') IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger
    WHERE tgrelid=to_regclass('teacher_onboarding_terminal_session')
      AND tgname='trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session' AND NOT tgisinternal
) AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger
    WHERE tgrelid=to_regclass('teacher_onboarding_terminal_session')
      AND tgname='trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_delete' AND NOT tgisinternal
) AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger
    WHERE tgrelid=to_regclass('teacher_onboarding_terminal_session')
      AND tgname='trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_truncate' AND NOT tgisinternal
) AS session_contract_ready
`).Scan(&denseSchemaReady, &productSchemaReady, &handoffSchemaReady, &sessionContractReady); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if !denseSchemaReady {
			return errors.New("teacher dialog dense-turn schema is not ready")
		}
		if err := dialogJobRepository.CheckDenseOrderingReadiness(ctx); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if cfg.ProductAwareOnboardingEnabled && !productSchemaReady {
			return errors.New("teacher product-aware onboarding schema is not ready")
		}
		if cfg.OnboardingPlannerHandoffEnabled && !handoffSchemaReady {
			return errors.New("teacher onboarding handoff schema is not ready")
		}
		if !sessionContractReady {
			return errors.New("teacher onboarding session contract migration 023 is not ready")
		}
		if handoffSchemaReady && !handoffCredentialConfigured {
			var pendingHandoffs bool
			if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff WHERE status IN ('queued','dispatching','accepted','message_pending','active_path'))`).Scan(&pendingHandoffs); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if pendingHandoffs {
				return errors.New("teacher onboarding handoff ledger cannot drain without LEARNING_PLANNER_TEACHER_TOKEN")
			}
		}
		return nil
	}
	healthHandler := &privatehandlers.HealthHandler{
		Ready: readyCheck,
		ReadinessFailureCode: func(err error) string {
			if errors.Is(err, pgadapter.ErrDenseTeacherOrderingDisabledWithPendingV2) {
				return "dense_teacher_ordering_disabled_with_pending_v2"
			}
			return ""
		},
		Capabilities: map[string]string{
			"teacher_dialog_v2_reader":           "true",
			"teacher_dialog_dense_claiming":      fmt.Sprintf("%t", cfg.TeacherDialogDenseOrderingEnabled),
			"teacher_product_aware_onboarding":   fmt.Sprintf("%t", cfg.ProductAwareOnboardingEnabled),
			"teacher_onboarding_planner_handoff": fmt.Sprintf("%t", cfg.OnboardingPlannerHandoffEnabled),
			"teacher_onboarding_path_outcome":    fmt.Sprintf("%t", cfg.OnboardingPathOutcomeEnabled && pathOutcomeSchemaInstalled),
			"teacher_next_best_action":           fmt.Sprintf("%t", cfg.NextBestActionEnabled),
			"teacher_dialog_rollout_sequence":    "teacher-schema-reader-then-claim-then-dialog-producer",
		},
	}

	router := httptransport.NewRouter(httptransport.RouterDependencies{
		APIPersonalTeacher:   apiTeacherHandler,
		APITeacherDialog:     apiTeacherDialogHandler,
		APICurriculum:        apiCurriculumHandler,
		APILearningSession:   apiLearningSessionHandler,
		APITelegram:          apiTelegramHandler,
		APIOnboarding:        apiOnboardingHandler,
		APINextBestAction:    apiNextBestActionHandler,
		AdminPersonalTeacher: adminTeacherHandler,
		PrivateHealth:        healthHandler,
		InternalToken:        cfg.InternalAPIToken,
		TelegramWebhook:      telegramWebhookHandler,
	})
	server := &http.Server{
		Addr:              net.JoinHostPort(cfg.HTTPBindAddress, cfg.HTTPPort),
		Handler:           router,
		ReadHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second,
		ReadTimeout:       15 * time.Second,
		WriteTimeout:      30 * time.Second,
		IdleTimeout:       60 * time.Second,
	}

	serverErrors := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		serverErrors <- server.ListenAndServe()
	}()
	logger.Info("teacher-agent listening", zap.String("address", server.Addr))

	signalContext, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()
	select {
	case serverErr := <-serverErrors:
		if !errors.Is(serverErr, http.ErrServerClosed) {
			logger.Fatal("http server failed", zap.Error(serverErr))
		}
	case <-signalContext.Done():
		shutdownTimeout := time.Duration(cfg.ShutdownTimeout) * time.Second
		if shutdownTimeout <= 0 {
			shutdownTimeout = 10 * time.Second
		}
		shutdownContext, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), shutdownTimeout)
		defer cancel()
		if err := server.Shutdown(shutdownContext); err != nil {
			logger.Error("graceful shutdown failed", zap.Error(err))
		}
	}
}

func runOnboardingHandoffWorker(ctx context.Context, logger *zap.Logger, worker *onboarding.HandoffWorker, interval time.Duration) {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		for {
			claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(ctx)
			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
				logger.Warn("onboarding handoff attempt failed", zap.Error(err))
			}
			if !claimed || ctx.Err() != nil {
				break
			}
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}

func runTelegramWorker(ctx context.Context, logger *zap.Logger, worker telegramuc.DeliveryWorker, interval time.Duration) {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		for {
			claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(ctx)
			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
				logger.Warn("Telegram delivery attempt failed", zap.Error(err))
			}
			if !claimed || ctx.Err() != nil {
				break
			}
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}

func runOutboxRelay(ctx context.Context, logger *zap.Logger, relay outboxuc.Relay, interval time.Duration) {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-ticker.C:
			claimed, err := relay.ProcessBatch(ctx)
			if err != nil {
				logger.Warn("outbox relay batch failed", zap.Int("claimed", claimed), zap.Error(err))
			}
		}
	}
}

func runTeacherDialogWorker(
	ctx context.Context,
	logger *zap.Logger,
	worker teacherdialog.Worker,
	interval time.Duration,
	batchSize int,
) {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		for processed := 0; processed < batchSize; processed++ {
			claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(ctx)
			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
				logger.Warn("teacher dialog job attempt failed", zap.Error(err))
			}
			if !claimed {
				break
			}
			if ctx.Err() != nil {
				return
			}
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}
